title: Add error handling to LocalKnowledgeResolver and RestMemoryGateway
description: LocalKnowledgeResolver calls SearchAsync without error handling (crash on transient HTTP failure). RestMemoryGateway.CreatePageAsync throws unhandled on HTTP failure; UpdatePageAsync PUT failure path silently propagates with no logging. Add try/catch matching MemorySmithBlueprintRepository pattern. Source: codebase-audit-20260711-10agent-swarm-5chair-council-post-wave-c.md.

comments.author: anonymous
comments.body: **Scope expanded by internal audit Sprint 60 (2026-07-11):** Additional error handling gaps found beyond the original scope: (1) GetPageAsync has no transport-level error handling for DNS/TLS failures, (2) UpdatePageAsync both PUT branches have no try/catch, (3) CreatePageAsync silently ignores the `type` parameter from the interface. See TSK-0401 for the combined fix task.

comments.author: anonymous
comments.body: Partial scope covered by TSK-0401 (Backlog). The CreatePageAsync GetPageAsync transport-level error handling and UpdatePageAsync error handling remain. The LocalKnowledgeResolver and CreatePageAsync error handling from the original scope are still pending.
